body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0157 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Net.exe domain group enumeration - Behavior: Net.exe domain group enumeration. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 1 net group/user /domain"
    severity = "Low"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0157"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1087.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\net\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\net1\.exe$/ nocase)
    ($e.target.process.command_line = /group/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\/domain/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /user \/domain/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
